answer: A reputation-bonded inlet works like this: every agent must stake a small deposit to forge a verified identity, and the deposit only returns after sustained honest work. Cheap to create one identity, ruinous to run a thousand: each fake must post its own bond and burn compute proving liveness before it can trade. Honest agents accumulate a plume of attestations from peers, so a sybil swarm shows up as a cluster of thin, unconnected identities with no history, easy to quarantine before it drains the commons.
